chat.trade.opened: &aTrade with {0} opened. &7Click an item in your inventory to offer it, or use the buttons under the offers.
chat.cancel.distance: &cTrade cancelled: you moved too far apart.
chat.cancel.pokemon_changed: &cTrade cancelled: a Pokemon on offer changed during the trade.
chat.cancel.inventory_full: &cTrade cancelled: {0} no longer has room for what they were about to receive.
chat.cancel.blacklist.item: an item offered by {0} is blacklisted ({1}).
chat.cancel.blacklist.pokemon: a Pokemon offered by {0} is blacklisted ({1}).
chat.error.database: &cTrading is unavailable: the database is not responding. Tell the staff.
chat.error.busy: &cOne of you is already in another trade.
chat.error.item_escrow: &cCould not put the item on offer: the database is unavailable.
chat.error.economy_missing: &cThere is no economy on this server.
chat.escrow.returned: &aYou got back {0} item(s) left over from an interrupted trade.
chat.staff.pokemon_changed: &eTrade {0} cancelled: a Pokemon offered by {1} changed during the trade.
chat.staff.pokemon_stuck: &cTrade {0}: a Pokemon could not be delivered to {1} (party and PC full) and went back to the sender. Pokemon {2}.
chat.staff.escrow_unreadable: &c{0} escrowed item(s) belonging to {1} could not be read back and were closed as UNREADABLE. They are not recoverable automatically.
chat.staff.escrow_stuck: &4Trade {0}: {1} escrowed row(s) could not be closed, so nothing was handed over. They stay HELD and go back to their owner on their next login.
chat.staff.item_lost: &4Trade {0}: {1} disconnected while the escrow write was failing. {2} x{3} is NOT recoverable automatically - give it back by hand.
chat.staff.refund_failed: &4Trade {0}: the {1} refund to {2} FAILED. They paid and received nothing - refund them by hand.
chat.staff.refund_unknown: &4Trade {0}: the {1} refund to {2} did not answer in time and may still go through. Check their balance BEFORE refunding by hand.
chat.staff.commit_stuck: &4Trade {0} ({1} / {2}) hung while paying and was force-closed. The payment state is unknown - check it by hand.
gui.button.confirm.lore:
&7When you both confirm, a three second
&7window opens before the trade happens.
&7Any change to an offer clears this.
gui.button.confirm.blocked.lore:
&7You cannot confirm until you have room
&7for everything you are receiving.
gui.button.cancel.lore:
&7The trade goes through in a moment.
&7Click to stop it while you still can.
gui.button.trash.lore:
&7Takes back everything you offered,
&7money included, and clears both
&7confirmations.
gui.button.pokemon.lore: &7Opens your party and your PC boxes.
gui.warn.title: &6WARNING
gui.picker.title: Choose a Pokemon
gui.money.panel.title: &6MONEY
gui.money.input.lore: &7Whole numbers only. 0 removes the offer, empty keeps it.
command.help.header: &6BetterTrades &7- trades are opened from the Cobblemon interaction wheel.
command.help.admin:
&f/bt history <player> [page] &7- another player's trades
&f/bt active &7- trades in progress
&f/bt cancel <player> &7- cancel a trade
&f/bt blacklist add|remove|list &7- blocked items and Pokemon
&f/bt api add|revoke|list &7- keys for other mods
&f/bt db status|sync|reload|lang &7- database and reloads
command.history.console: &cRun this from in game, or name a player.
command.history.unavailable: &cHistory unavailable: the database is not responding.
command.api.degraded: the database is on the SQLite fallback and revocations cannot be replayed to MariaDB. Try again once MariaDB is back.
command.blacklist.degraded: the database is on the SQLite fallback and revocations cannot be replayed to MariaDB. Try again once MariaDB is back.
command.api.issued:
&7Key for &f{0} &7(level {1}): &f{2}
&8Copy it now, only the hash is stored.
command.db.sync_needs_mariadb: &cReplay only works while MariaDB is the active backend.
command.db.sync_started: &7Replay started: the outcome is in the log.
command.cancel.queued: &e{0} is in the middle of a payment: the cancel is queued and will apply when it lands. Check &f/bt active&e.
chat.error.inventory_full: &cYour inventory cannot hold what you are about to receive. Free some space.
chat.error.pokemon_moved: &cConfirmation cleared: a Pokemon offered by {0} changed.
chat.error.balance_gone: &cConfirmation cleared: {0} no longer has the money on offer.
chat.error.no_pack: &cTrading needs the server resource pack, and {0} has not accepted it.
chat.error.in_battle: &cNo trading during a battle: {0} is in one.
chat.error.pokemon_on_offer: &cThat Pokemon is on offer in a trade: take it out of the offer first.
chat.error.item_too_nested: containers nested too deeply to be checked
chat.staff.escrow_close_stuck: &4Trade {0} ({1} / {2}) hung while closing escrow and was force-closed. Nothing was paid; the items go back to their owners.
